decisions.reason: Having survived the first review round and fitting closely into the established automation portfolio, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping while customer adoption and reference effects become clearer.

As a close-to-core mechanical addition with likely higher support and production costs than software, it is somewhat more exposed, but municipal infrastructure sales cycles are long enough that management would keep the option open for another year.

This product matches the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, energy-efficient infrastructure and can leverage existing software and service capabilities, so its option value is high and withdrawal risk is low.

A dedicated multi-model line in a familiar application area suggests meaningful strategic commitment, so despite hardware carrying costs the firm would keep it on the market until demand is revealed more fully.
